name: ADX MACD Deev
summary: This EA combines the ADX indicator to measure trend strength with the MACD oscillator for momentum-based entry signals. It opens buy trades when MACD crosses above its signal line while ADX confirms a strong trend, and sells on the opposite conditions. The strategy aims to capture momentum moves only in confirmed trending markets, filtering out weak or sideways conditions.
summary_zh: 该EA结合ADX指标衡量趋势强度与MACD振荡器提供动量入场信号。当MACD上穿信号线且ADX确认趋势强劲时开多单，反之开空单。策略仅在确认的趋势市场中捕捉动量行情，过滤弱势或震荡市场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于ADX趋势强度过滤与MACD动量交叉的双重确认机制。入场条件为：MACD主线与信号线交叉（金叉做多、死叉做空），同时ADX值需超过阈值以确认趋势存在。出场条件依赖MACD反向交叉信号平仓，部分版本可能加入固定止盈止损。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理较为基础，缺乏动态风险调整机制，未根据波动率或账户权益变化进行仓位缩放。整体而言，策略逻辑清晰但较为传统，ADX过滤有效减少了震荡市场的假信号，但MACD滞后性可能导致入场偏晚，错过趋势初段利润。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is built on a dual-confirmation mechanism combining ADX trend strength filtering with MACD momentum crossover signals. Entry conditions require MACD main line crossing above the signal line for buys (and below for sells), while simultaneously ADX must exceed a threshold to confirm a trending market exists. Exit conditions rely on MACD reverse crossover signals for closing positions, with some versions potentially including fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing typically uses fixed lot sizes or a balance-based calculation method. Money management is relatively basic, lacking dynamic risk adjustment mechanisms that scale position size based on volatility or account equity changes. Overall, the strategy logic is clear but conventional; ADX filtering effectively reduces false signals in ranging markets, but MACD's inherent lag may cause late entries, missing the initial portion of trend moves.

parameters.name: ADX_Level
parameters.description: ADX趋势强度阈值，高于此值才开仓
parameters.description_en: ADX trend strength threshold, only open positions above this value

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

pros: ADX趋势过滤有效减少震荡市假信号，提高信号质量
双指标确认机制逻辑清晰，易于理解和优化
MACD动量交叉是经典可靠的趋势跟踪方法，经过长期市场验证
pros_en: ADX trend filtering effectively reduces false signals in sideways markets, improving signal quality
Dual-indicator confirmation logic is clear and easy to understand and optimize
MACD momentum crossover is a proven and reliable trend-following method validated over decades of market use
cons: MACD固有滞后性导致入场偏晚，可能错失趋势初段利润
缺乏动态仓位管理，未根据市场波动率调整风险敞口
止损止盈设置可能不完善，默认值为0意味着依赖反向信号平仓，面临较大回撤风险
cons_en: MACD's inherent lag causes late entries, potentially missing the initial portion of trend moves
Lacks dynamic position sizing that adjusts risk exposure based on market volatility
Stop-loss and take-profit may be inadequately configured; default values of 0 mean reliance on reverse signals for exits, exposing larger drawdown risk
improvements: 加入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整出场水平
增加新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线内多次重复开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that automatically adjusts exit levels based on market volatility
Implement new bar checking mechanism to prevent multiple duplicate entries within the same candle

risk_points: 默认止损为0，完全依赖反向信号平仓，在剧烈行情中可能造成大幅亏损
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓，增加风险敞口
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss of 0 means full reliance on reverse signal exits, which can cause significant losses during volatile market moves
Lack of new bar checking may lead to duplicate entries on the same signal, increasing risk exposure
